voice.description:
Voice selection: by `name` from the predefined catalogue, or by raw `id`.

BACKWARD COMPATIBILITY IS THE CONSTRAINT HERE. `{"voice": {"id": "<uuid>"}}` is already in
production, so `id` keeps working untouched and always WINS over `name`. `id` merely became
optional, which is strictly more permissive — no request that used to succeed can now fail.
`name` is the new default path: it renders as a dropdown in the fal playground because a
Literal becomes an enum in the JSON schema.

style_instructions.description: Optional style and delivery instructions prepended to the prompt. Controls expressiveness, accent, pace, tone, and emotional expression using natural language. Examples: 'Speak warmly and slowly', 'Read this as a dramatic newscast', 'Use a British accent with a cheerful tone', 'Whisper mysteriously'.

prompt.description: The text to convert to speech. Gemini 3.1 Flash TTS supports natural-language prompting for style, pace, accent, and emotional expression — include delivery instructions inline with the text (e.g. 'Say cheerfully: Have a wonderful day!'). Supports expressive audio tags like [sigh], [laughing], [whispering], [short pause] for fine-grained control over delivery. For multi-speaker synthesis, prefix lines with speaker aliases defined in the speakers field (e.g. 'Alice: Hello!\nBob: Hi!').
